name: Paladin - Sunbreaker Artillery
description: This playstyle completely abandons the standard Paladin toolkit of heavy melee strikes and reactive healing, replacing it with mechanics that require strict positioning and resource management to bombard enemies from afar.

bonuses.text: The radius of your ground-targeted spells is increased by 20%.

items.name: Restored Sun-Lens
items.stats:
+120 Intellect
+85 Haste
Equip: Converts Judgment into a ground-targeted AoE ability.
items.flavor: A focused crystal that bends the light to your will.

origin.details: Drops from the final boss of a mid-tier Scarlet Crusade-themed dungeon.

catalyst.details: Polish the fractured lens, then infuse it with dusk.

items.name: Pauldrons of the Dawn
items.stats:
+140 Intellect
+95 Stamina
Equip: Causes Consecration to deploy at the location of your most recent Judgment.
items.flavor: Forged to cast shadows far across the battlefield.

origin.details: A rare drop from an elite mob in a max-level contested zone.

catalyst.details: Combine ingots of the sun and the protection of fire.

items.name: Scepter of the Sun King
items.stats:
+210 Intellect
+115 Critical Strike
Equip: Casting Holy Shock on an enemy standing in Consecration detonates the zone for massive AoE damage and resets Judgment.
items.flavor: The hollow core now burns with the fury of a dying star.

origin.baseName: Hollowed Scepter of the Sun King
origin.details: A guaranteed drop from a specific mini-boss within the first endgame raid tier.

catalyst.details: Fill the hollowed inset and amplify with holy power.
